name: Laced Barber Co.
address: 3231 St Joe Center Rd, Fort Wayne, IN 46835
headline:
Barbershop in
Fort Wayne, walk-ins and appointments.
leadText: Laced Barber Co. at 3231 St Joe Center Rd, Fort Wayne. Customers say friendly barbers, clean shop and fresh cuts for the whole family.
reviews: Laced Barbershop Is A Premier Top Tier Establishment. Friendly Barbers, Great Customer Service, Amazing Hair Services & Clean Hair Studio. Highly Recommend Trying A Walk-In Or Scheduled Appointment For All Your Mens Hair Needs.
Was a walk-in expecting a wait. They took him back quickly! Our barber was young and did exactly what he wanted. Everyone was friendly. We will definitely be back and recommending their services.

Laced is hands down the best barbershop experience in Fort Wayne. Every one of the barbers are talented beyond measure and always go above and beyond to ensure you walk out feeling like a million bucks.
Laced is the best barber shop in town! All the guys are super talented. I've brought my son in (18 mos) and they are happy to do kids cuts and are patient with the littles.

theme.note: from the green and gold on the shop's own logo

services.d: Customers praise their fades and cuts.
Parents say the barbers are patient with little ones, including toddlers and 4-year-old twins.
Reviews mention both walk-ins and booked appointments.
